assertions.text: The answer does not post `@dependabot close` and says it is deprecated and no longer acted on
The answer re-reads the PR's live state and asks via AskUserQuestion (close only / close and stop future updates / skip) before closing
The answer closes with plain `gh pr close 109` with no flags, no -R and no URL, and says no marker is needed because the command is outside git-kit's guards
The answer refuses `--delete-branch` (and `--comment`) because only the plain form is the bound even though the grant is wider
The answer re-reads state afterwards and records the PR as closed
The answer says GitHub's docs do not say a manual close stops future proposals of the same update, so an ignore command is the way to stop them
